values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 47 individual sites plus a group site: 35 Standard Non Electric, 4 Popup/Tent and 8 Tent Only. Max vehicle length is 15-20 ft at all but four: #11 and #12 (35-ft pull-throughs), #15 (35 ft, back-in) and #38 (25 ft, back-in), so only those four take a 23-ft motorhome.

note: Campsites under tall pines; DCR calls them some of the largest and most private in Massachusetts. A firsthand reviewer warned the wooded access roads are tight over ~18 ft, so book one of the long sites and expect tight maneuvering. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica + mass.gov: $17 MA / $54 non-resident (2026 fee table, unchanged), 2026 season 5/14-10/11 (unchanged), no hookups, no dump, bathhouse with showers, reservations required (no walk-ins), 14-day cumulative summer limit. Per-site lengths: only #11, #12, #15 (35 ft) and #38 (25 ft) take a rig over 20 ft; max 35, 2 pull-throughs. Note cleaned (dropped the field facts and the wrong '#5, #10' large-site examples - RA lists #5 as a 20-ft popup/tent site and #10 at 20 ft). No 2027 schedule or fees posted yet.
flags: Phone: mass.gov and ReserveAmerica give the campground office as (978) 597-2850; the stored 978-597-8802 is the year-round/off-season number. Consider storing 978-597-2850 (campground) or both.

Rig length (not a criteria problem - the agency's own per-site figures run to 35 ft): only 4 of the 39 sites that take a trailer/RV allow more than 20 ft on ReserveAmerica (#11, #12 and #15 at 35 ft, #38 at 25 ft), so a 23-ft motorhome has four bookable sites.

Pin unverified: the campground loops are under continuous pine canopy on Esri imagery and cannot be resolved. ReserveAmerica's GPS (42.65528,-71.76028) is ~245 m WSW of the stored pin, and OSM's 'Pearl Hill Campground' node (42.65338,-71.76672) ~810 m WSW; neither is per-site data, so the pin is left alone. The stored pin sits near the park entrance/HQ by the day-use pond.
